free_tier.stated: no free tier; the cheapest plan is General Purpose 1 vCPU, 1 GB DDR5, 25 GB NVMe, 3 Gbps port, unmetered bandwidth, KVM, at USD 4.99 a month (USD 3.49 for the first month on a first server), USD 49.90 a year or USD 89.82 for 24 months; location Virginia, USA
free_tier.notes: the next rung is Cost-Optimized 2 vCPU, 4 GB DDR4, 40 GB local NVMe, 1 Gbps at USD 9.99 a month; General Purpose 1 vCPU / 2 GB is USD 8.99 a month with 50 GB NVMe

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not stored bytes; billed in advance for a monthly, yearly or 24-month period

egress.terms: bandwidth is stated as unmetered on every plan, over a 3 Gbps port on General Purpose and a 1 Gbps port on Cost-Optimized

interface_detail: Raff API, CLI, Terraform provider and MCP server; browser terminal and SSH with root access
tooling: Raff API, CLI and Terraform provider; 20+ OS templates; the page documents no third-party client
chaining: one location, Virginia, so it adds a US-east vantage with free private networking between a customer's own Raff servers

limits.value: 25 GB NVMe on the 1 vCPU / 1 GB plan, 50 GB on 1 vCPU / 2 GB
3 Gbps port on General Purpose, 1 Gbps on Cost-Optimized

binding_note: the 25 GB disk of the cheapest plan fills before bandwidth does, since bandwidth is unmetered

identity_cost.detail: email address and password at signup; phone number verified by SMS before the first purchase ('Raff requires phone verification for security'); payment by card saved with the payment provider (USD 1.00 check charge credited to the account balance) or by a payment link when no card is saved; wire transfer and crypto through support; minimum age 18; no identity document named on the pages read

reliability_note: no outage or suspension event recorded; General Purpose carries a 99.9% SLA with 3x replicated NVMe, Cost-Optimized has local NVMe and no SLA
confidence_note: the 1 vCPU / 1 GB / 25 GB shape and the 3 Gbps port come from the provider's own offer post on a forum; the product page states the USD 4.99 price but its General Purpose plan table is not in the page text, so the shape has no first-party quote yet
